# endpointcentral_computer (Data Source)

Looks up one managed computer, for example to get the resource ID that `endpointcentral_custom_group_membership` takes. Set exactly one of `id`, `name` or `fqdn`; names are compared case-insensitively and must match exactly one computer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "endpointcentral_computer" "by_name" {
  name = "mac-studio-01"
}

data "endpointcentral_computer" "by_fqdn" {
  fqdn = "mac-studio-01.corp.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fqdn` (String) Fully qualified domain name.
- `id` (String) Resource ID.
- `name` (String) Computer name.

### Read-Only

- `agent_version` (String)
- `domain` (String) NetBIOS domain or workgroup.
- `ip_address` (String)
- `mac_address` (String)
- `os_name` (String)
- `os_version` (String)
- `platform` (String) `windows`, `mac` or `linux`.
- `remote_office` (String) Name of the remote office the computer belongs to.
